title: Heteronuclear MO theory
basic_overview: Heteronuclear AOs differ in energy; bonding MOs are polarised toward the more electronegative atom.

extra_info_content.short_trick: Lower-energy AO contributes more to bonding MO.
extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Rank AO energies. 2. Combine matching symmetry. 3. Fill MOs. 4. Determine polarity and BO.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
